data.action: 趴在窗边木桌上托腮打盹
data.description: 【羽毛笔 · 雨窗微困】雨水连绵的午后，拉菲艾拉双手托腮趴在休息室的圆木桌上，小脑袋一点一点地打着瞌睡，长长的睫毛在白皙的面颊上投下柔和的阴影。察觉到你在她身上搭了件薄毯，她软糯地哼唧了一声——「唔……好暖和……谢谢博士……」
data.lighting: soft diffused overcast light, reflective rainy window, warm indoor lamp glow
data.promptProse: La Pluma dozes with both palms supporting her cheeks beside the rain-streaked window. A blanket newly laid across her shoulders catches the warm indoor lamplight against the cool grey afternoon outside.
data.title: 羽毛笔 · 雨窗微困
